# bridge-conformance

> Fault-injection harness for services that receive payment and stablecoin status callbacks and post them to a ledger: duplicates, out-of-order events, lost responses and late retries, crashes between writes, stale replays, tampered and forged copies, with invariant checks and shrunk counterexamples. Engineering checklist, not legal advice.

Standard library only. Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks scheme. Three lifecycle models (instant, ach, onchain) and three reference receivers (naive, short-dedupe, careful). Tested on synthetic data only.

Built and maintained by Art Akopian, CEO of Banrox (https://banrox.com).

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/bridge-conformance/blob/main/README.md): Rules, lifecycles, adapter, what is real and what is not.
- [docs/sources.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/bridge-conformance/blob/main/docs/sources.md): Primary sources.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/bridge-conformance/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent skill for testing a receiver.

## Source

- [runner.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/bridge-conformance/blob/main/src/bridgeconf/runner.py): Delivery schedule, retries and the checks.
- [case.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/bridge-conformance/blob/main/src/bridgeconf/case.py): Histories and faults.
- [shrink.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/bridge-conformance/blob/main/src/bridgeconf/shrink.py): Cutting a failure down.
- [reference.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/bridge-conformance/blob/main/src/bridgeconf/reference.py): Reference receivers.

## Optional

- [examples/companions.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/bridge-conformance/blob/main/examples/companions.py): A receiver built from webhook-verify and idempotency-store.
